description: Adds the cells specified by a given set of conditions or criteria.

params.description: The range of cells to be evaluated.
params.name: arg1

params.description: The first condition or criteria in the form of a number, expression, or text that defines which cells will be added.
params.name: arg2

params.description: The first range to sum. If omitted, the cells in range are used.
params.name: arg3

params.description: Up to 127 additional conditions or criteria in the form of a number, expression, or text that defines which cells will be added.These arguments are optional.
params.name: arg4

params.description: Up to 127 actual ranges to be used to be added. If omitted, the cells in the range are used. These arguments are optional.
params.name: arg5

signature: SUMIFS(arg1: ApiRange | ApiName, arg2: ApiRange | ApiName | number | string, arg3?: ApiRange | ApiName, arg4?: ApiRange | ApiName | number | string, arg5?: ApiRange | ApiName): number
